rationale: The intraday spike to $25.43 failed and price has bled -4.9% off the high into a tight coil of five consecutive lower closes on evaporating volume (59k down to under 10k per 5-min bar), sitting just below the 9-EMA at only 26% of the day's range — evidence that buyers have stepped away after the failed thrust. Late-day vacuum drift after a failed momentum move tends to extend in the direction of the bleed toward the day's low/gap-fill zone near $23.75-$23.85. Risk is small above the coil high ($24.30, ~0.5% stop) against a ~1.6% target, roughly 3:1 reward-to-risk, sized modestly given the positive-news tailwind (sentiment +0.93) that could spark a late re-launch.
